title: xUAn1573's handcuffs
description: This mod adds Handcuffs to Minecraft. Use them to permanently disable the AI of any living entity, making it harmless and completely inactive while preserving normal physics and interactions.
body:
# Handcuffs

Handcuffs is a simple Forge mod for **Minecraft 1.20.1** that adds a new item used to permanently disable the AI of living entities.

## Features

* Adds a new **Handcuffs** item.
* Craftable using **2 Iron Ingots** and **1 Lead**.
* Can be used on almost any **Living Entity**, including most vanilla mobs and many Forge modded entities.
* Applying Handcuffs permanently disables the entity's AI.
* Handcuffed entities no longer move, attack, flee, patrol, or perform any AI behaviors.
* The AI-disabled state is saved with the world and remains after reloading.
* Does not modify vanilla entity classes or require Mixins, improving compatibility with other Forge mods.

## Crafting Recipe

```
[ ] [ ] [ ]
[Iron Ingot] [Lead] [Iron Ingot]
[ ] [ ] [ ]
```

## Compatibility

* Minecraft Java Edition **1.20.1**
* Forge **47.x**
* Java **17**

This mod is designed to work with vanilla living entities and many Forge modded entities that inherit from `LivingEntity`. Compatibility may vary for entities with heavily customized behavior.
